thread.title: Opening of Under Armour's Fifth Avenue New York store delayed until 2021

author: Holden Wilen
title: Opening of Under Armour's Fifth Avenue New York store delayed until 2021
text: – Reporter, Baltimore Business Journal Dec 13, 2018, 11:07am EST Under Armour Inc. still plans to open a flagship store on Fifth Avenue in New York but has significantly pushed back the timeline. CFO David Bergman said at the sportswear maker's investor day on Wednesday that Under Armour plans to take possession of the 53,000-square-foot space on the first floor of the General Motors building in the first half of 2020. He said Under Armour expects to open its store in the first half of 2021. The "pinnacle brand expression store," as Bergman described it, will be located in the space that used to be occupied by the iconic FAO Schwarz toy store and put Under Armour's logo in a prime Manhattan shopping destination for tourists. FAO Schwarz closed its toy store in 2015, but opened a new one earlier this year at 30 Rockefeller Plaza. Bergman's comments represent a two-year shift from Under Armour's original timeline. As recently as August, Under Armour said there were no changes to the company's original plans of opening the Fifth Avenue store in 2019. CEO Kevin Plank announced plans to open the store in 2016. He said Under Armour would "build one of the most breathtaking retail experiences" at the location, which was used in the famous piano-playing scene in Tom Hanks' 1988 comedy "Big." At the time of Plank's announcement,Under Armour (NYSE: UAA) was still in the midst of its streak of 26 consecutive quarters with 20 percent or more sales growth. But the company hit a slowdown in North American sales and took on a cost-cutting plan . As part of its tightening, the company backed out of a deal that would have made it the official on-field outfitter for Major League Baseball, a decision that reportedly saved Under Armour $50 million. Under Armour is also laying off 400 employees as part of its restructuring plan. New York real estate news site The Real Deal estimated in 2016 that Under Armour's lease at the Fifth Avenue space will cost $30 million annually. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL) has been occupying the space and was still there as of Dec. 4, according to 9to5Mac . The tech giant has been operating out of the former FAO Schwarz space temporarily while its famous glass cube-topped underground store undergoes renovations. Officials from Boston Properties, which has a majority ownership stake in the General Motors building, could not be reached. Under Armour has 80 brand houses globally, including 15 in North America. Locations include Baltimore's Harbor East, Chicago's Michigan Avenue and downtown Boston. Under Armour also has a brand house in New York's SoHo neighborhood.
